properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 19 at 12:39PM PDT until October 20 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 6
feet with local sets as high as 8 feet. Highest surf on south
and southwest facing beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County coastal areas and Orange County
coastal areas.

* WHEN...Through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Areas of hazardous swimming conditions. Rip currents
can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can wash
people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across
south- facing beaches.
properties.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT NOW IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING

properties.areaDesc: Ventura County Beaches; Malibu Coast; Los Angeles County Beaches
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 19 at 12:31PM PDT until October 23 at 3:00AM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to
elevated surf of 3 to 6 feet expected.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles
County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion and tidal overflows may
occur across south-facing beaches especially along the Malibu
Coast and in the Long Beach area.
properties.instruction:
Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.

NWSheadline: BEACH HAZARDS STATEMENT NOW IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE THURSDAY NIGHT
